Optional PDF runtime: pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT), PDF.js/pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 (Apache-2.0). Built by tools/pf09-build-pdf.mjs from operator-installed packages. PDF.js bundled CMaps and standard fonts retain their upstream licenses in the original package standard_fonts/LICENSE_* and cmaps/LICENSE. Engine registration pins all generated asset hashes. These runtime assets are not redistributed in this repository.
